snippet.title: Extreme Forklifting 3 - Announce Trailer!
snippet.description:
Experience the thrilling life of a warehouse giraffe. Use your trusty forklifts to solve problems and deliver pallets. Pick pallets up, put them down, the only limit is your imagination! 

Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172570/Extreme_Forklifting_3/

Game by: DevM Games
Trailer music by: Aki Knaappila
